summary: Man in his 20s climbing with two companions became stuck on a ledge ~50 ft above Horsetooth Falls on Thursday evening, unable to climb to safety; Poudre Fire Authority, Larimer County SAR, sheriff's deputies, parks crews and Poudre Valley Hospital EMS ran a high-angle rope rescue (dispatched 4:41 p.m., concluded ~7 p.m.); he was uninjured
location: Horsetooth Falls, Horsetooth Mountain Open Space, west of Fort Collins
responding_agency: Poudre Fire Authority; Larimer County Search and Rescue; Larimer County Sheriff's Office; Larimer County parks; Poudre Valley Hospital EMS
notes: Coloradoan/Beaconjournal 2016-05-12; date weekday-verified Thursday; first Horsetooth-area rescue of 2016
